notes: Identity assessed independently: title, Camerer/Dreber/Holzmeister and coauthor byline, DOI 10.1038/s41562-018-0399-z, and SOURCE_URL identify primary author supplementary information for the cited 2018 Nature Human Behaviour work. This is supplementary information, not the main article containing the supplied p. 4 locator; no PDF supplied. The scarcity/cognitive-fatigue description matches the Shah et al. study 1 Dots-Mixed attention-task comparison by its substantive description in Supplementary Table 1 and Methods p. 14, not by row order or study number 19. The assigned original side is Camerer et al.; its own replication results are candidates, whereas the Original Study columns refer to secondary Shah et al. 2012 results. Stage 1 candidate: N=278 observations (278 individuals), printed r=−0.087, exact p=0.150. Pooled Stage 2 candidate: N=619 observations (619 individuals), printed r=−0.015, exact p=0.710. The table heading explicitly labels Size (r); these are not printed F statistics. Table 1 F (1, 54) = 4.16 and p=0.046 describe the secondary Shah original, not Camerer's own test. Methods p. 10 documents Stage 2 as first and second data collection pooled. The supplied locator does not resolve stage; neither candidate is selected. No common analytic N across stages, N sum, df-derived N, or metric conversion. Methods p. 42 documents exclusions separately; no further subtraction from printed N.
